decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively attack the opponent, utilizing low-cost creatures like Voldaren Epicure, Sneaky Snacker, and Kitchen Imp. The deck also includes a mix of burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt to deal direct damage to the opponent or clear out blockers. The deck also includes cards like Alms of the Vein and Vampire's Kiss to gain life back while dealing damage. The mana base includes lands that provide colored mana and utility lands like Bojuka Bog for graveyard hate.

The main focus of this mono blue aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan with a combination of cheap counterspells and disruptive spells, while also maintaining card advantage through cantrips and card filtering. The deck aims to quickly pressure the opponent with evasive threats like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, while controlling the board and countering key spells with cards like Counterspell and Dispel. The overall strategy is to establish early dominance and maintain a tempo advantage until the opponent is overwhelmed.

This deck focuses on sacrificing artifacts and creatures to generate value and control the board, while also taking advantage of graveyard recursion and card draw. The goal is to constantly have resources to fuel aggressive plays and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using a mix of removal, sacrifice outlets, and recursion spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats and disruption, ultimately outpacing and outlasting them in the long game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly damage the opponent's life total through direct burn spells and aggressive creatures. By combining efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fiery Temper with creature-based damage from cards like Guttersnipe and Voldaren Epicure, the deck aims to deal constant damage while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with targeted removal. The inclusion of cards like Grab the Prize and Highway Robbery provide additional options for resource advantage and card selection, keeping the pressure on the opponent at all times.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost artifact creatures and utilizing affinity mechanics to cast spells for reduced cost. It also includes cards that generate card advantage and removal spells to control the board. The ability to sacrifice artifacts for additional benefits and deal direct damage to the opponent is another key aspect of the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressive play, efficient use of resources, and maintaining a strong presence on the battlefield.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a consistent flow of threats. By utilizing cheap, efficient spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to control the board, as well as cards like Thought Scour and Mental Note to enable graveyard synergy with Cryptic Serpent and Deem Inferior, this deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a proactive game plan and efficient use of resources.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Urza's lands to play powerful spells and control the game. It includes cards for card draw, removal, countering opponent's spells, and generating value with flicker effects. The key strategy is to assemble Urzatron as quickly as possible, while using control spells to stay alive and disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with efficient card advantage and powerful late-game threats, ultimately grinding out a win through attrition and overwhelming resources.

This control deck focuses on assembling the Urzatron lands - Urza's Tower, Mine, and Power Plant - to generate a large amount of colorless mana. It utilizes card draw, recursion, and counterspells to control the game while searching for the Urzatron pieces with Expedition Map and Crop Rotation. Mulldrifter and Mnemonic Wall provide additional card advantage and utility. The deck can generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful spells to take over the game, while also having answers to disrupt opponents' strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of Elves and pump them up with cards like Timberwatch Elf and Nyxborn Hydra. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through Distant Melody and Lead the Stampede, while utilizing mana dorks like Quirion Ranger and Priest of Titania to accelerate its game plan. With cards like Jaspera Sentinel and Elvish Vanguard to further strengthen the Elf tribe, this deck aims to quickly establish a dominating board presence and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on control elements while utilizing the card Ephemerate to create value through flickering creatures like Mulldrifter and Archaeomancer. The inclusion of Sunscape Familiar and God-Pharaoh's Faithful helps to maintain a stable board state against aggressive decks, while the use of card draw spells like Preordain and Deep Analysis ensures a consistent stream of resources. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by recurring key cards and controlling the game until it can establish a winning position through card advantage and efficient removal spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through removal spells and disruption while generating card advantage and gaining life. The Golgari / Jund Garden archetype utilizes a mixture of creatures, spells, and lands that can handle a variety of threats and establish a solid defense. By using cards like Defile, Snuff Out, and Crypt Rats, the deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent over the course of the game. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Pulse of Murasa and Lembas to gain life and recur key cards for additional value.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw in order to outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage and board presence. The deck utilizes counter spells like Counterspell and Spellstutter Sprite, removal spells like Snuff Out and Cast Down, as well as card draw and filtering with Brainstorm and Preordain. The creatures included also provide value through card advantage and tempo plays, such as Ninja of the Deep Hours and Faerie Seer.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and cheap artifacts, while also benefiting from sacrificing artifacts to power up spells like Galvanic Blast. The deck aims to maintain a steady flow of artifacts to fuel powerful abilities and deal damage efficiently. Additionally, it includes cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Krark-Clan Shaman to disrupt the opponent's strategy and gain an advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on utilizing the affinity mechanic to its fullest potential and outpacing the opponent with a relentless assault.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures using cards like Satyr Wayfinder and Stinkweed Imp, then bring them back onto the battlefield with spells like Dread Return and Exhume. Cards like Gnaw to the Bone and Malevolent Rumble help to protect your creatures until you can assemble your combo. The key strategy is to leverage the reanimation theme to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures like Lotleth Giant and Troll of Khazad-dûm, while maintaining card advantage using Generous Ent and Circle of the Land Druid.

This deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with cheap, efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent while utilizing spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to protect them. The deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage through cards like Thought Scour and Ponder. By combining aggression with disruption, this Mono Blue Aggro deck looks to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this Pauper 1 vs 1 UR Control deck is to control the game through countering opponent's spells, removing threats with removal spells like Skred and Lightning Bolt, and generating card advantage with cards like Augur of Bolas and Ninja of the Deep Hours. The deck also utilizes faeries like Spellstutter Sprite for disruption and card filtering with Faerie Seer. The inclusion of card draw, cantrips, and versatile spells like Lórien Revealed and Brainstorm allows the deck to maintain a consistent game plan while adapting to different situations.
